newsitem.title: USA: Kvaerner Metals stays in Pittsburgh.
newsitem.headline: Kvaerner Metals stays in Pittsburgh.

text.p: Kvaerner Metals said Thursday it signed a letter of intent to move its Pittsburgh office and U.S. headquarters, from One Oliver Plaza to Penn Liberty Plaza 1, at 12th and Liberty in the Strip District of the city, by April 1998.
The Pittsburgh operation is part of Kvaerner A/S of Norway.
The company, which performs projects worldwide, supplies engineering and construction services, process equipment and automation services, primarily to metallurgical industries.
"By choosing this location, we are making a long-term commitment to our employees and to the city of Pittsburgh," said Jim McGrath, senior vice president, responsible for the Pittsburgh operation.
In its current location, the Pittsburgh office employs nearly 750 people and occupies about 200,000 square feet of office space, the company said.
